_comment: Per-casualty terminal goal condition, plus universal obligations that apply regardless of which route a plan takes. Universal obligations are checked in executor.py pass 5, independent of route recognition -- see salvage_plan_checker.md's completeness checks (C1-C6) and methods.py RouteRegistry.

aground.description: Vessel refloated, stable, and either under tow or left safely in place.

capsized.description: Vessel righted (or removed/cut up), crew safe, stability restored.

sunken.description: Vessel raised, or made safe in place with pollution controlled (leave_and_mitigate route).

on_fire.description: Fire out, spaces stable, no reflash risk.

universal_obligations.note: Only load-bearing for routes that disturb the hull; not NOT_ATTEMPTED-blocking for tide_refloat (no intervention at all) or abandon_in_place (offload IS its core_tools, not an obligation on top of it). except_routes is read by executor.py pass 5 -- do not add a route name here without checking obligations_for()'s call site.
Cargo/hazmat accounted for before cutting or movement.

Only applies when scenario.habitat_sensitive is true (see scenario.py's _habitat_sensitive proxy) -- requires_scenario_field is read by executor.py pass 5, obligation is skipped entirely when that scenario attribute is falsy.
